messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: high error rate spike for service=embed-service region=us-east-1 :rotating_light:
oncall-bot: 80% 5xx for last 5m, paging SRE-oncall
maria: i'm on it, digging into logs now
chris: i see a sudden surge of 502s from aws-nlb in front of embed-service, any deploys in last 10m?
jia: deploy-bot: rollback initiated for commit f2c3a4 (embed-service) by chris
chris: yep i kicked a rollback, monitoring
maria: raw log pattern looks like "backend=\"embed-core\" error=\"upstream 502\"" — repeating every ~3s. suspect NLB target draining flaps
oliver: can we mute the alert noise? current alert thresholds are spamming pages, need a quick stopgap
maria: good call. will add a temporary suppression for the alert rule for 10m while we stabilize
chris: done: adjusted datadog monitor embed-5xx-rate from threshold 5%->10% for 10m via console
maria: adding a regex exclusion to avoid known noisy signature from health-check proxy. proposed filter:

```
NOT message =~ "upstream 502" AND service:embed-service
```

but we actually want to exclude only health-check path. better:

```
NOT (message =~ "GET /hc" AND message =~ "upstream 502")
```

suggest applying as an add-on filter to the log-based alert rule
jia: +1 on scoped exclusion. please paste full log-query for source control
maria: log query (for logs-platform):

```
source:prod| service:embed-service | exclude("GET /hc" and "upstream 502") | count by status_code
```

we'll add as a new signature so we can revert easily
chris: created ticket SRE-4122 to track. also created a small Grafana panel in the incident dashboard showing 5xx by backend and by nlb-target-id
oliver: dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/incident-embed-502
maria: summary for handoff: rollback started at 1923004612, 5xx rate down from 80% -> 12% in 8m, temporary monitor suppression applied, exclusion regex pushed to staging rule, ticket SRE-4122 created, dashboard tile added, followups: refine regex signature, add k8s readiness probe check, add alert runbook entry
chris: note: customers with high throughput experienced elevated latencies but no data loss reported (we saw retries but responses recovered)
maria: tagging oncall for next shift — oliver please take for next 12h and follow up with post-incident runbook + postmortem
oliver: will do. plan: tomorrow morning implement a tighter long-term fix — NLB target health-check tuning + implement exponential backoff in embed-client
oncall-bot: Handoff: duty transferred to oliver at 1923004799
maria: thanks team :thumbsup:
chris: leaving a small snippet to add to alert rule history so we have audit trail:

```
# 1923004618 - temporary threshold bump to 10% for 10m, added exclusion for GET /hc 502s, linked SRE-4122
```

maria: will follow up with a concise postmortem draft tomorrow morning
oliver: acknowledged, i'll take ownership of SRE-4122 and update status by EOD PST
